heroHeadline: White Nile State Cleared of RSF — SAF Announces Strategic Milestone; RSF/SPLM-N Drone Destroys Dilling Medical Warehouses Days After Treaty of Jeddah Signing
heroSubtitle: On Day 1133, SAF declared White Nile State fully cleared of RSF presence — a key logistical milestone securing SAF's supply corridor to the Kordofan and Blue Nile fronts. The announcement contrasts sharply with renewed RSF/SPLM-N drone strikes: Dilling's medical warehouses were completely destroyed by a rebel drone (Wednesday evening), depriving thousands of patients of medicines just 24–48 hours after SAF broke the city's siege for the third time. A drone strike on a crowded market in Ghubaysh, West Kordofan on May 19 killed at least 28 civilians — among the deadliest single strikes of the month. The Treaty of Jeddah, signed May 20 committing both parties to civilian protection, faces immediate credibility challenges as both sides continue attacking civilian infrastructure. Total displacement remains 14 million+ with 19.5 million facing acute food insecurity; the June–August lean-season peak of 28.9 million approaches as the 2026 humanitarian appeal remains only ~20% funded.
